title: You can overcome fornication... Watch how this saint was delivered from the spirit of fornication
paragraphs: not seeking to be noticed he's seeking for the Deep things of God to serve God in spirit and in truth my name is my prayer request for today was for me to die to self so um as I was going to Papa um for the prayer with my prayer request after some the vibration inside me even inside my mouth like my mouth was kind of shaking and then I knew that I was going to receive from God even when I was

sitting down I was really praying that Papa should touch me just to lay his hands on me because um the challenges have been going through um on the past few months which included fornication and then in which way um last week I had Papa in the dream praying for me but before that when I was still um in this sin of fornication not knowing how to get out not knowing who to tell how to say it because of Shame um there

was a time that um in this dream I was like in the church here and then Papa was preaching and then he was saying you will go to hell and then I knew that you were speaking to me because of the sin the Bible said flee this thing can mess you up anything that God do you know who God is he said flee you are you are you are no stronger than God who said flee you're not wiser than God who

said when it comes to immorality adultery and fornication flee and then it really didn't sit well I really got when I woke up from that I was scared but you know then you console yourself and then you lie to yourself and then you tell yourself that maybe it's a demon you know it's not Papa and then I continued again and then Papa again appeared in the dream and then he said you will die and then now it is really getting into

me I was not happy at all but I didn't know who to tell about this I didn't know how to share it because you know sometimes you share with their brothers and then they want to go tell somebody else and then you don't want to be painted as that kind of a person you know and the third dream that up here to me he was like also preaching in a setup of the church but it didn't look like it was here

and then you said he came close to me like as if you know when papa is preaching and then you want to come close to your face something like that he said um you must talk about the realm of the Lost Souls and then I knew that from there that if I continue that is the realm where I'm gonna end I don't know life from there everything stopped you know that that Ash to sin to fall into fornication he stopped because

I was thinking like the realm of the Lost Souls it must not be like a really good place obviously and then I fasted for seven days after that after fasting for seven days because sometimes we fast and then we don't really see the results of the fasting we fast you lose weight you don't really see what's what is happening in the spiritual realms so I fasted seven days yes I lost weight and all that but then I didn't see anything you

know a day after that I finished um in this August beginning August the day after I finished my seven days of fasting trying to fight the spirit of fornication I felt into sin again same thing and then on the same night that I fell into the scene that's when now God opened up to me on what happens when you when you when you fast and then you fall into the same scene again it was like um I was in this apartment

the apartment was clean and like white is I don't know that kind of white like very clean even the air in the apartment and it was like I'm the one who have cleaned it you know and I was proud of myself that I've cleaned my apartment like this just so clean like I've never seen it like that and there was an old man that came he was drinking something and then he said he was tired you want to sit down and

then as a cool person as I never could come in and sit down and say you know it's my apartment you can sit down and then when you when you're ready to go you can go again and then the old man started he was drinking whatever I was drinking and he started to to to to have something like diarrhea and then he was messing up on himself and then he pen you can then now as he panicked he was touching the

walls of this apartment this clean apartment that I've been like worked so hard to clean ah and I thought the whole apartment I was dating all of it and I was really so sad in my spirit that after when I woke up I understood what I've done to myself and then um I prayed again and then I fasted again after I went over fasting with the church and then that was when I saw Papa now praying for me in the church

and then when I was coming to these prayers on the last prayers of the two days I was still praying that Baba could really touch me and and pray for me so that I can understand that whatever that I was going through that he spoke about death and hell I will not be going there and then as today as I came forth to pray for my family inside I was praying to the holy spirit that I'm tired of myself I want

to die to myself and live for God it's not seeking to be noticed he's seeking for the Deep things of God to serve God in spirit and in truth not prophecy not not nothing else but the spirit of the fear of God that's it well when the men of God touched me uh prayed for me the um the vibrations in my body are kind of my mind was gone I was just vibrating even now I was still feeling something in my

stomach right now I'm really feeling so um so happy so excited so so relaxed I have hope again you know because I was really losing hope but again because I lived most of my life in the world I knew that going back to the world is never an option it doesn't matter what happens I'm not going back it is really difficult to overcome it by yourself um and one of the reasons why you you you struggle is because you want to

do it by yourself and then there's this a shame that is over you that you know that you're not supposed to be doing this but you're still doing it and now you don't want to share it's better to share with people or come straight to the man of God and not be scared to me I was feeling like there was other peace other people who have more serious cases than me now I don't want to bother the man of God with

this case maybe I can do it by myself you know you know all the lies of the devil but um anybody who's going through that it is better because you can fast until following the same thing like I did because I fasted seven days and then I did it on there on the second day after the fasting I'd rather come to the man of God humble yourself open up the man of God we pray for you and you'll be delivered special
